identity.one_line: A spider-form ambusher using Widowmaker, bites, corrosive toxins, brood effects, burrow/pursuit, and venom detonations. It is more direct than Venom but more position-dependent, with strong PvP-shaped control and execute pressure.

mechanics.core_loop: A spider-form ambusher using Widowmaker, bites, corrosive toxins, brood effects, burrow/pursuit, and venom detonations. It is more direct than Venom but more position-dependent, with strong PvP-shaped control and execute pressure.

modes.name: Widowmaker
modes.structural_description: Requires Spider FormConsumes Brood MarksInject shadow venom into an enemy, dealing Shadow damage and reducing their healing received by 50% for 8 seconds. 1 Mark: 55 + 56.25% shadow SP Shadow damage. 2 Marks: 70 + 72% shadow SP Shadow damage. 3 Marks: 90 + 92.25% shadow SP Shadow damage. 4 Marks: 114 + 117% shadow SP Shadow damage. 5 Marks: 154 + 157.5% shadow SP Shadow damage.

modes.name: Widow's Kiss
modes.structural_description: Every 3rd Venom Fang becomes Widow's Kiss, dealing increased damage and granting you increased haste.Widow's Kiss (Transform)Applies 1 Brood MarkBite an enemy for 91 + 50% shadow SP + 30% AP Shadow damage, increasing your haste by 20% for 4 seconds. Scales with modifiers to Venom Fang.

modes.name: Rotfang
modes.structural_description: Requires Spider FormConsumes Brood MarksInject venom into an enemy that rots them from the inside out, dealing Plague damage over 24 seconds. 1 Mark: 240 + 220% SP Plague damage. 2 Marks: 307 + 281.6% SP Plague damage. 3 Marks: 394 + 360.8% SP Plague damage. 4 Marks: 499 + 457.6% SP Plague damage. 5 Marks: 672 + 616% SP Plague damage.Damage dealt pierces absorption effects and resistances.

modes.name: Facemelter
modes.structural_description: Requires Spider FormConsumes Brood MarksSpray poison upon an enemy and nearby enemies, dealing Nature damage over 15 seconds. 1 Mark: 88 + 93.75% nature SP Nature damage. 2 Marks: 112 + 120% nature SP Nature damage. 3 Marks: 144 + 153.75% nature SP Nature damage. 4 Marks: 182 + 195% nature SP Nature damage. 5 Marks: 245 + 262.5% nature SP Nature damage.

modes.name: Serpent Lord
modes.structural_description: Augments Spider Form into a Serpent Lord, giving some of your Spider Form abilities a 1 second cast time and 10 yds of increased range.Damage is increased when attacking an enemy past 10 yds by 30% and spell pushback from enemy attacks is reduced by 50%.Increases the damage of Withering Venom by 50% and causes it to create a Miasma.Miasma (Talent)Create an 8 yd cloud of poison at a location for 12 seconds, causing 57 + 12.5% nature SP Nature Damage to 8 enemies within it every 2 sec.

modes.name: Brood Lord
modes.structural_description: Augments Spider Form into a Brood Lord, causing your Brood Mark spenders to launch webs at the target, sticking to them for 10 seconds.Each webbed target has their movement speed slowed by -25%.Critically striking an enemy who is webbed summons 1 to 2 Spiderlings to aid you in combat for 8 seconds.

modes.name: Cunning of the Nerub'ar
modes.structural_description: Augments your Spider Form, increasing your damage dealt by 10% and causing it to allow your Nerubian Sting to stack 1 additional time.
